note: Events for the gallery. Date, location and summary come from the invoice for the job, not from photo metadata. Frames reference an event by key and inherit its values.

montgomery-wow-2025.name: Montgomery WOW 2025
montgomery-wow-2025.summary: Onsite video support for Montgomery WOW across several production days. The current frames show both the presentation environment and the formal event room; add operator and full-stage views if available.

solomute.name: SoloMute
solomute.summary: A set of artist-branded live-visual tests and performance environments spanning indoor and outdoor LED stages. The material is strongest as a visual-development study: content on real screens, stage-scale tests, and the relationship between the SoloMute identity and different spaces.

juneteenth-urban-oasis-baltimore-2024.name: Juneteenth Urban Oasis Baltimore 2024
juneteenth-urban-oasis-baltimore-2024.summary: Video support for a Juneteenth program at Baltimore’s Urban Oasis, with an outdoor stage and large-format screen framed by the surrounding architecture. Use stage, audience, and control images to connect the cultural program with the technical delivery.

congressional-black-caucus-week.name: Congressional Black Caucus Week
congressional-black-caucus-week.summary: A multi-event CBC Week production spanning LED stages, branded screen content, ballroom programming, and backstage video systems. The gallery follows the work from unloaded panels and road cases through live show looks across several rooms.

qts-data-center.name: QTS Data Center
qts-data-center.summary: Repeat video engineering for multi-camera corporate programs across several show days. The most useful images will show switching and playback, the operator position, stage displays, and the clean program environment those systems supported.

soweto-amapiano-2024.name: Soweto Amapiano 2024
soweto-amapiano-2024.summary: Two nights of live video operation for a Soweto/Amapiano program, pairing cultural performance with large-format screen content. Strong selects should capture stage composition, dance-floor energy, screen design, and live playback.

entergy-party-2024.name: Entergy Party 2024
entergy-party-2024.summary: A compact branded event environment built around vertical LED columns, an illuminated control booth, and Entergy content. Add wider room views and live-program moments if they are available.

f1-event-2025.name: F1 Event 2025
f1-event-2025.summary: A Formula 1 viewing event built around a large indoor screen and a shared audience experience. The strongest edit will pair the race feed and crowd with the temporary display system that made the room work.

dc-wharf.name: DC Wharf
dc-wharf.summary: Recurring waterfront V1 and video-wall work supporting festivals, movie nights, cultural programming, and seasonal public events. The strongest edit will combine the operational backbone with wide public-facing views that show how the system changes from event to event.

capitals-game-2025.name: Capitals Game 2025
capitals-game-2025.summary: Live video operation for a Capitals game-viewing environment at the Wharf, combining a large outdoor screen with a crowd-facing waterfront setup. The current exports show the display, audience, control feed, and the system before and during the event.

amfest-2025.name: AMFest 2025
amfest-2025.summary: Full-cycle video production for a festival environment, from LED and stage load-in through live V1 operation and strike. Strong selects would pair wide stage and crowd views with the control position and playback system behind them.

2025-capitol-summit.name: 2025 Capitol Summit
2025-capitol-summit.summary: A corporate summit environment centered on a wide-format red stage canvas and a clean presentation layout. Add room-wide, speaker, control-position, and content-detail frames if more are available.

gogo-festival-2025.name: GoGo Festival 2025
gogo-festival-2025.summary: Live video operation for a Go-Go festival at Charles County Fairgrounds, connecting performance, LED content, and a crowd-facing stage system. Prioritize performers, audience energy, wide stage views, and the playback position.

staunton-wedding-2025.name: Staunton Wedding 2025
staunton-wedding-2025.summary: Two days of live video operation for a destination wedding program in Staunton. The current export is a team image; add stage, screen, room, and playback views before treating it as a public-facing gallery story.
